settings.payOnlineNotSetUp: Not set up yet. Ask your developer to connect a payment gateway.
settings.payAtCounter: Pay at the counter (QR or cash)

settings.noPaymentOption: Customers can't order online until a payment option is on.

today.closedNow: The shop is closed by its opening hours.

ownerOnTablet.body: Sales, reports, staff and settings never open on the shared shop tablet. Sign in on your phone or computer.

search.title: Search
search.start: Type an order number, order ID, phone or name.

menu.subtitleOwner: Edit items, prices and availability. Changes reach the customer menu immediately.

dashboard.title: Sales Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: How today is trading against the same day last week.
